title: Tetractys is the Shadow on the Wall - Step Beyond the Veil
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
Yesterday we learned how to count to five. Let's see if we can do the same another way...

Source (The Dual Projective) creates but ONE Degree (of Geometric) Freedom -- DOF -- which He gives to Us.

Geometric means equivalent space and equivalent time. The Holy Trinity of The Affine, The Metric, and The Euclidean.

Equivalent space is 1-dimensional. Every "point" can be referenced to every other "point" by a straight line of ONE (equivalent) spatial dimension. Again. We. Do. Not. View. Space. And. Time. *ahem* We. Can. *Not*. Look. Upon. True. Good. And. Evil.

We cannot look upon the true Light. We would be Blinded by the Light (the Funky Break is the Dark Night of the Soul). Blinded not in that we would permanently lose our sense of vision but rather we would "see" Nothing. The Great Abyss. We manifest equivalent space and equivalent time.

As an analogy: bounce a pure ray of light (as Yourself) off a mirror (unit boundary) and tell me what you see with respect to Yourself. Hint: 'with respect to' always refers to a unit boundary. Absolute magnitude can only be "measured" from Unity i.e. a unit boundary. So what happens if light finds itself as a boundary and also with respect to another boundary? Is that even possible?

From All & Not All comes apparent One & Not One.

The proof? As a personal exercise*, try to re-create the Tetractys with no more than one cross ratio from All/Not All. We need the roots to conjugate into everything else. Cant' be done that way (on the left). There must always remain an everywhere/everywhen link to Source.

* would recommend you use good, old-fashioned MS Paint -- truly blank slate -- for the ultimate experience. Think: how do I do this? No cheating and using a grid or other external measuring device -- You are your own reference (light). Hint: mine is purposefully *not* perfect and is the key to understanding how to make it perfect. The loss of perfection (net/equivalent shift) creates dimensions.
